Sophie: Quick heads-up for tonight's Sunset Rooftop + webinar. Short list: swag arrival status, webinar backup plan, lead QR routing, and speaking replacement. Can folks ack their items by 16:30?

Ravi: Swag pallet delayed at AMS customs; customs wants invoice clarification. If not cleared by 18:00 we'll use printed discount cards + stickers we have local.

Amanda: Printing local postcards now for discount codes. Generating 150 unique codes in Stripe. ETA printing 18:45.

Nina: Webinar ops: stream + RTMP ready. If keynote can't join we'll run pre-record + a live panel. Need pre-record by 17:00. I'll moderate Q&A.

Tom: Confirm stream check at 17:30. Backup hotspot and battery pack in bag. Bringing spare HDMI and mic.

CJ: Demo ops: switching demo instance to small-quant model to keep noise down. Demo creds rotated and in 1Password. Also bringing tabletop bench cards.

events-bot: Venue update: Outdoor rooftop confirmed, indoor backup room reserved at 7:30. Power access left of Stage B. Contact Pieter +31-20-555-0000.

Sophie: Lead flow: QR -> Typeform -> Zapier -> HubSpot -> assign to events-eu SDRs. Amanda please confirm Zap fields and test.

Amanda: Zap test passed at 16:40. Fields: name, email, company, interest, utm_source=rooftop. HubSpot contact + task created. Screenshot in drive.

Ravi: Messaging tweak for cards: front "Predictable inference. Predictable cost." back has 2-line stat + QR. Nina ok with messaging?

Nina: Change "Predictable" to "SLA-grade" on front. Also add line: "Dedicated pools for mid-market teams."

Sophie: Final checklist: pre-record by 17:00, stream test 17:30, swag pivot decided by 18:00, postcards printed 18:45, lead zap test done. Flag blockers here. Thanks! :raised_hands:
